## User Stories

### Create base EmptyState component structure
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create a reusable EmptyState component so that I can consistently display empty state messaging across the application
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component accepts message prop for customizable text
  - [ ] Component follows design system typography and spacing
  - [ ] Component is responsive on different screen sizes
  - [ ] Component has basic unit tests

### Implement EmptyStateIcon component
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create an EmptyStateIcon component so that I can visually communicate empty states to users
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Icon component accepts icon/illustration prop
  - [ ] Icon follows design system sizing guidelines
  - [ ] Icon is responsive and scales appropriately
  - [ ] Component has basic unit tests

### Integrate EmptyState with EmptyStateIcon
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to combine the EmptyState and EmptyStateIcon components so that I can display a complete empty state UI pattern
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] EmptyState component properly renders EmptyStateIcon
  - [ ] Components are properly aligned and spaced
  - [ ] Integration tests verify proper rendering
  - [ ] Documentation includes usage examples


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
